headings.usage: Massive scale for heroes (text-6xl+), tight tracking (tracking-tighter). Used for primary section titles and kinetic text.
headings.styles: No Inter for headings. Use Sora for a distinct geometric, editorial edge.

body.usage: Clean, highly readable text-base or text-lg for paragraphs. Loose line height (leading-relaxed).

accents.usage: Uppercase, tracking-[0.2em], text-xs or text-sm for labels, node identifiers, overlines, and architectural annotations.

primary.name: Deep Teal
primary.usage: Buttons, active states, key data nodes

text.name: Near-Black
text.usage: Primary typography, main headings, heavy contrast lines

support.name: Muted Sage
support.usage: Secondary background panels, subtle highlights, muted editorial blocks

accent.name: Terracotta
accent.usage: Hover interactions, 'X' motif highlights, urgent CTAs, line intersections

border.name: Soft Border
border.usage: Grid lines, component outlines, architectural dividers

surface.name: White Cards
surface.usage: Elevated cards, form containers, distinct workflow nodes

visual_enhancers: The 'X' Motif: Use absolute positioning to place tiny '+' or 'x' marks (using text or SVG) at the intersections of grid lines.
Blueprint Lines: Use 1px solid borders (#D9D7D0) that extend fully to the edges of the screen (using grid or absolute spans) to create an architectural, wireframe feel.
Editorial Spacing: Massive padding between sections (py-32). Negative space is crucial for the luxury consulting feel.
Node Labels: Small floating labels on images or cards (e.g., 'Fig. 1', 'Node A') to reinforce the systems studio vibe.

components.cards: Flat, White (#FFFFFF), 1px solid border (#D9D7D0), 0px or 4px border-radius. No generic drop shadows. Instead, use a hard 4px offset shadow in Deep Teal on hover for an editorial tactile feel.
components.buttons: Sharp corners or subtle 2px rounding. Default: Deep Teal bg, White text. Hover: Terracotta bg, White text. Include a subtle arrow icon that translates right on hover.
components.inputs: Shadcn default inputs but remove rounded corners (rounded-none), use #D9D7D0 for borders, and #194D4A for focus rings. Minimalist form styling.
components.navigation: Solid background (#F6F3EC) or highly saturated crystal glass (bg-[#F6F3EC]/80 backdrop-blur-xl). Bottom border #D9D7D0. Links in near-black, hover terracotta.
components.footer: Dark mode flipped. Background Near-Black (#151A18), text Warm Ivory (#F6F3EC). Massive type for the brand name, strict grid for links.

grids_and_layouts.global_grid: 12-column CSS Grid. Emphasize asymmetry. Do not center everything. Left-align most text.
grids_and_layouts.bento_blueprint: Use the Mode A 'Tetris' Grid for the Approach section. Mix large structural images with small text blocks to create tension.
grids_and_layouts.borders: Expose the skeleton. Give containers border-r and border-b using the soft border color to create a continuous table/grid look across sections.

motion.smooth_scroll: MANDATORY: Implement @studio-freight/react-lenis for buttery smooth scrolling. Standard scroll feels cheap.
motion.kinetic_hero: MANDATORY: Line-by-line staggered reveal. Split text into visual lines, wrap in overflow-hidden divs, and stagger translate-y from 100% to 0 using framer-motion variants.
motion.editorial_marquee: Use react-fast-marquee. Slow, smooth drift. Near-black uppercase text with wide tracking, separated by the 'X' motif or bullet points.
motion.scroll_reveals: Framer motion `whileInView` with `viewport={{ once: true, margin: '-100px' }}`. Subtle Y-axis slide (20px) and fade in.
motion.parallax: Use Framer Motion `useScroll` and `useTransform` to slightly move hero images or background grid nodes at a different speed than the scroll.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure Near-Black on Warm Ivory passes WCAG AAA. White text on Deep Teal is AA+. Terracotta on White is AA.
accessibility.reduced_motion: Wrap all framer-motion transitions with a `prefers-reduced-motion` check or use standard CSS media queries for base animations.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include `data-testid` attributes (e.g., `data-testid='book-call-button'`).

media.icons: lucide-react. Set strokeWidth to 1.5. Use geometric icons (ArrowRight, MoveDiagonal, Crosshair, Grid, Box).
media.3d_libraries: Framer Motion 3D for subtle scrolling transformations. Avoid heavy 3D 'glowing brains' or generic tech gears as requested.

instructions_to_main_agent: Do not use generic SaaS dashboard vectors, gears, or glowing AI brains.
Install and use `lenis` for smooth scrolling. This is required for the premium Awwwards feel.
Install `framer-motion` for kinetic typography and scroll reveals.
Install `react-fast-marquee` for the editorial scrolling text strip.
For the Hero Section, create a staggered line-by-line reveal animation using framer-motion variants on overflow-hidden containers.

Use Shadcn components for complex interactions (Accordion for FAQ, Form for Contact) but strip their default styling. Apply the #FFFFFF background, #D9D7D0 borders, and flat designs (no large shadow blurs).
For the TidyCal embed, create a responsive container that loads the inline widget script, with a styled fallback button just in case.
Use 1px grid borders heavily to create an architectural 'blueprint' aesthetic. Use the 'X' symbol subtly at grid intersections.
Ensure all code is written in `.js` / `.jsx` as per environment constraints. Do not use `.tsx` syntax.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) only where it makes sense (e.g., sticky headers). For this brand, prefer solid architectural panels.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
